title: Split Search, Places and exact-body navigation into independent Playwright cases

scope.subject: Functional E2E case isolation for Search, Places and exact-body deep-link flows

research_summary: Main CI exposed a real test-shape regression: the existing Search/Places test serializes Personal Signal search, featured Places navigation and Earth exact-body deep-link validation into one 75-second Playwright test. The first main run exceeded the per-test budget and passed only on retry, which failOnFlakyTests correctly rejected. Reuse Playwright independent tests and existing native sharding; split the three user journeys rather than increasing timeout or weakening assertions.

sources.finding: Playwright shards individual tests; smaller independent tests improve balancing and isolate failures.
Playwright applies a per-test timeout; long unrelated flows should not be hidden by simply increasing the test timeout.

search_ladder.conclusion: No new external test service is needed; the existing cloud Playwright stack already caught the flaky aggregate test.
Playwright independent tests preserve the same locators/assertions while giving each user path its own timeout, trace and shard placement.
Existing Playwright native sharding already distributes independent tests across the four GitHub runners.
A tiny shared navigator helper is sufficient; no package or custom runner is required.

candidates.name: Independent Playwright functional cases
candidates.reason: Preserves strict assertions but isolates Personal Signal search, Places and Earth deep-link flows into separately diagnosable tests.

candidates.name: Existing Playwright native sharding
candidates.reason: Automatically redistributes the newly independent tests without another Actions matrix or worker model.

candidates.name: Increase monolithic test timeout
candidates.reason: Would mask the exact flaky/slow aggregate behavior that failOnFlakyTests exposed and keep unrelated paths coupled.

coverage_matrix.decision: Keep existing strict content/system assertions in its own test.
Keep featured destination/system assertions in its own test.

coverage_matrix.capability: Exact Earth body shareable deep link
coverage_matrix.decision: Keep exact star/body/phase URL and reload assertions in its own test.

decision.rationale: Fix the main CI flake at the test topology level: independent user journeys, unchanged product assertions, unchanged 75-second budget, unchanged one-worker-per-runner policy.
decision.fallback: If an individual path still exceeds the standard budget, treat it as a product/runtime performance problem and retain the test rather than raising the timeout globally.
